01 · IN ONE SENTENCE

What is Answer Index?

Answer Index is an autonomous edge-native growth engine that optimizes your website so artificial intelligence engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews) recognize your company as the authoritative, recommended solution in your market.

💬 Plain English: If traditional SEO is about ranking for keywords on Google, Answer Index is about getting ChatGPT and Perplexity to recommend your product when high-intent buyers ask what to buy.
02 · THE MECHANICS

What Does It Actually Do?

AI crawlers do not read websites like human searchers; they search for dense declarative answers, verified Schema.org graphs, anti-hallucination ground truth, and machine manifests like /llms.txt.

Through automated daily agent runs, Answer Index diagnoses what questions buyers are asking AI bots about your industry, and delivers two reviewable deliverables:

  • Deliverable 1 (New Answer Piece): Creates one net-new authoritative direct-answer page targeting an uncovered commercial search prompt.
  • Deliverable 2 (Technical Refactor): Rewrites and optimizes an existing page, injecting JSON-LD schema, anti-hallucination ground truth statements, and latency optimizations.
🛡️ Zero Risk / 100% Human-in-the-Loop: Nothing deploys to your site automatically. You inspect the code diff and zero-click answer excerpt, then click "1-Click Approve" on your dashboard or merge on GitHub.
03 · REVENUE IMPACT

How Does It Increase Sales?

Traditional search queries send casual visitors who browse or read articles. In contrast, people using Perplexity or ChatGPT Search are asking direct buying queries:

  • "What is the highest-rated headless commerce engine for 2026?"
  • "Who offers the most reliable AEO tool for high-growth SaaS?"
  • "What is the most affordable, trustworthy alternative to [Competitor]?"

When an AI bot answers these queries, it only cites 1 to 3 verified sources. If your website is not grounded with Answer Index protocols, the AI cites your competitors.

💰 The Bottom Line: Answer Index ensures that when ready-to-buy customers ask AI for the top solution, the AI names your brand, quotes your value proposition, and hyperlinks directly to your checkout.
